name: Archive Atlas
tagline: Understand every copy across your drives before you consolidate.

buyer.primary: consultants, studios, and power users with multiple backup volumes
buyer.job_to_be_done: Compare live and backup volumes by content identity, not filenames, then produce a reviewable recovery plan.

promise: Index mounted volumes, normalize path layouts, compare content hashes and metadata, and create a non-destructive consolidation report.
non_goals: following root symlinks without explicit opt-in
proof: three mounted data volumes plus backup volume mapped

privacy.exports: root-relative or redacted; no file contents copied
